title: Lo Alamdar Alamdar Alamdar Chala
body:
Lo Alamdar, Alamdar alamdar chala x2
1 Maskh khande par rakhi x2
Pyaas kuch aur badi x2
Aagayi wo bhi gadi x2
Janibe neher chali leke farare ki hawa
Lo Alamdar Alamdar Alamdar chala x2
2 Shor mojo se utha x2
Marhaba sakeala x2
Boli ghazi pe wafa x2
Ke siwaai ko bada sarko jhukay dariya
Lo Alamdar Alamdar Alamdar chala x2
3 Pani chulu me liya x2
Door se ek tir laga x2
Di sakina ko sada x2
Pani lata hey meri jaah abhi tera sakah
Lo Alamdar Alamdar Alamdar chala x2
4 Mashk barmati bhari x2
Khud bhi pyasa tha jari x2
Tashnagi kehtirahi x2
Pani piley e alamdar moka he mila x2
Lo Alamdar Alamdar Alamdar chala x2
5 Fir bhi pani na piya x2
Pyas ko bhul gaya x2
Sani e sher e khuda x2
Apne gode ko su e khemey jari le ke muda
Lo Alamdar Alamdar Alamdar chala x2
6 Shirf kohsish thi yehi x2
Pani pohcha ey abhi x2
Koi hasrat na hu e x2
Na daha mashke sakina pe laga tir e jafa
Lo Alamdar Alamdar chala
7 Tir par tir chale x2
Shaan e ghazi ke katey x2
Run me abbas ghire x2
Kehteteh aao madad ko mere ibne zehra
Lo Alamdar Alamdar Alamdar x2
8 Aake laashe pe ghire x2
Shahedi rote hue x2
Phir yeh farmane lage x2
Chod gaye tum bhi hame daste bala me tanha
Lo Alamdar Alamdar Alamdar chala x2
